subject: Request: sandbox access pause — PO stuck in DocuSign / temporary buffer
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir@solacehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@solacehealth.com, Eva Liao <eva.liao@solacehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox pause — PO in DocuSign, can we hold the timer?

Hi Rachel,

Quick one from procurement — our PO is routed and signed by engineering but the DocuSign is sitting with our finance team for a final approval (they asked for a few clarifying line items on data retention). We expect resolution early next week but the sandbox timer is counting down and product + sales need to keep the demo live through Tuesday.

Is there a way to pause the countdown or give us a small buffer (5–7 days) while finance completes review? Were committed to moving to Redwood once the PO clears; this is just a housekeeping request to avoid losing momentum.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Kapoor
Head of Platform, Solace Health
samir@solacehealth.com

--
Attachment: Solace_PO_DocuSign_status.pdf (status snapshot)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@solacehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox pause — PO in DocuSign, can we hold the timer?

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and the status PDF.

Were happy to help preserve the demo while finance completes the signoff. Ill loop in Kimberly (billing) and Sean (CS) to confirm the fastest way to keep the environment live. A short bridge is usually possible if procurement confirms the PO is in-flight and theres an expected sign date.

Can you confirm: 1) expected sign date (or range), 2) whether DocuSign has any redlines outstanding, and 3) tell us if the finance contact (Eva) needs anything from Redwood to unblock?

If procurement needs something in writing from our side, I can provide a short note committing to the PO terms you shared.

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

--
Quick note: Im marking this as time-sensitive internally (were flexible to grant a short buffer).

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Sandbox pause — PO in DocuSign, can we hold the timer?

Thanks for the context. From a billing perspective we can provision a temporary 7-day sandbox credit to keep their demo live while DocuSign completes. Conditions:
- Must be recorded in HubSpot (deal SOL-2025-0912) with expected sign date noted.
- Credit is revocable if the PO is not executed after the 7-day buffer.
- No transfer to production; this is strictly demo/sandbox usage.

Ill attach the temporary credit CSV for ops to apply. Rachel, can you confirm the expected sign date back to Samir and ask Eva if they need a short written note from Redwood confirming were holding the environment until the PO clears?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachment: temp-7day-sandbox-credit-20250615.csv (apply with account id)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@solacehealth.com>, Eva Liao <eva.liao@solacehealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox pause — PO in DocuSign, can we hold the timer?

Samir / Eva — quick update: weve put a temporary 7-day sandbox buffer on Solaces account tied to deal SOL-2025-0912.

What we need from you to finalize this:
- A best-effort sign date (even a range like "by 6/24") to include in HubSpot
- Confirmation that the DocuSign is the final step (no additional redlines)

Kim has uploaded the credit file and ops will apply it this evening. This buffer will keep the demo environment active through next Tuesday; if the PO is not executed after that window we will follow up and discuss next steps.

If Eva needs a brief written note from Redwood stating were holding the environment pending PO execution, say the word and Ill draft it.

Thanks — happy to escalate if you run into any snags with finance.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: Solace_PO_DocuSign_status.pdf (re-sent for visibility)
